feed.title: Verilay Patchmap: Desktop and apps on Windows Server 2025

entry.title: Now fixed: USB audio devices might fail to start or produce no sound
entry.summary: Started with KB5122871. Fixed in KB5131080. Affects: Windows Server 2025. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/release-health/status-windows-server-2025#4984msgdesc. From Microsoft release health.
